children: Scholastic reported Q1 FY27 revenue of $216.8M, down 4%, and an operating loss of $92.2M. The company affirmed FY27 guidance for revenue growth of ~2%-4% and Adjusted EBITDA of ~$135M-$145M, and expects Free Cash Flow of ~$35M-$40M.

Q1 revenue $216.8M, down 4%
Top-line decline reflects Education and Children’s softness; sets tone into peak season.
Q1 operating loss $92.2M
Loss roughly in line YoY; seasonally weak quarter but cash burn matters.
FY27 revenue +~2%–4% affirmed
Maintaining guidance signals management confidence into back-to-school/fall.
FY27 Adj. EBITDA ~$135M–$145M
Improvement vs FY26 on comparable basis; key profitability yardstick.
Entertainment revenue +$6.5M to $20.1M
Diversification offsetting weakness elsewhere; pipeline growth noted.
Net cash used ops $94.6M vs $81.8M
Higher cash use on working capital and sale-leaseback rent; liquidity watch.
Context by AI Analyst

This is an early-season checkpoint in a seasonally small quarter, with guidance reaffirmation framing expectations ahead of peak periods. A beat in back-to-school Book Fairs and sustained Entertainment momentum, alongside easing Education budget pressure, would turn this into a stronger catalyst.
